svg.title: PortföyOptim: BIST 30 portfolio optimisation
svg.desc: Project plate for PortföyOptim drawn as a route map: market data, then feature engineering, then ARIMA and GARCH forecasts, then Black-Litterman and LSTM blending, ending at Monte Carlo portfolio weights. The 30 BIST 30 tickers modelled by the project run along the lower edge: AEFES, AKBNK, ASELS, ASTOR, BIMAS, DSTKF, EKGYO, ENKAI, EREGL, FROTO, GARAN, GUBRF, ISCTR, KCHOL, KRDMD, MGROS, PETKM, PGSUS, SAHOL, SASA, SISE, TAVHL, TCELL, THYAO, TOASO, TRALT, TTKOM, TUPRS, ULKER, YKBNK.
